synchronization.strategy: fresh branch from exact current main after SEC-031 merged; preserve other work and remain zero commits behind main before PR creation

implemented: explicit read-only Docker Engine backend attestation and fail-closed direct-socket override
fixed GET-only Docker Engine operation allowlist with no arbitrary API path or HTTP method
daemon ping and normalized host/engine health observation
bounded normalized container inventory without commands labels environment or host mount sources
shared request item byte fan-out and total-time query budgets with rate and concurrency limits
finite historical container log tails with upstream tail since until timestamps stdout and stderr
Docker multiplexed log stream normalization without exposing raw framing
bounded log line count response bytes time window and per-line characters
best-effort password token API-key authorization and bearer credential-pattern redaction in returned log messages
strict Docker container ID or simple-name validation preventing caller-controlled API path traversal
finite recent Docker event windows with server-calculated since and until values
fixed event object-type allowlist for container image volume network and daemon
event actor attribute minimization to name image container exitCode and signal with labels excluded
typed operation results with actor reason correlation ID audit events and no result payload duplication in audit metadata
contract capabilities explicitly declare no live log follow no live event stream and no writes
documentation and deployment configuration for log/event load guards and read-only authorization proxy endpoint allowlisting
security_boundary: production should use a least-privilege HTTPS authorization proxy because a read-only filesystem mount of the Docker socket is still protocol-privileged
no exec attach create start stop restart kill delete pull push build or arbitrary Engine API operation
log and event calls always use a finite time window and shared response-byte budget; no live streaming mode is exposed
container log content remains potentially sensitive after best-effort credential redaction and is deliberately bounded
event labels and arbitrary actor attributes are never returned
caller input cannot select an arbitrary Docker API path query key HTTP method host or credential
writes remain absent; any future write layer requires a separate backend identity and plan approval change verify idempotency pre-state rollback intent and independent readback
